name: app-fashion-online-store-screens-magenta-gradient-filters
title: Fashion Online Store app screens: magenta gradient onboarding, account, categories and filter panels
whatItIs: Four phone screens with a magenta-to-purple gradient: an onboarding screen with a shopping photo and 'Start Shopping' button, an account screen with sign-up/log-in buttons, a categories grid (Men's, Women's Clothing, Cosmetics, Shoes) and a filters panel with colour swatches, a price slider and size buttons.
whatItMeans: Vivid and energetic; one bold gradient across every screen makes a fashion app feel youthful and distinctive.
techniques: Apply one consistent gradient across every screen for brand recognition.
Use a 2x2 photo grid for category browsing.
Offer colour swatches directly inside the filter panel.

vocabulary.definition: A UI section for narrowing results by attributes like size or price.
A grid of images representing browsable product groups.
